{"id":1595322322,"question_id":3152,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1743665712,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1595322322/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Value of an Ordered Triplet II","memory":"91 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long maximumTripletValue(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int max_i = 0;\n        long long result = 0;\n        int maxDiff = 0;\n\n        for(int j =0 ; j<nums.size() ; j++)\n        {\n            result = max(result , (long long)maxDiff * nums[j]);\n            maxDiff = max(maxDiff , max_i - nums[j]);\n            max_i = max(max_i , nums[j]);\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-value-of-an-ordered-triplet-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":531}
